dimensions.rationale: Actual sewer separation, reliable heat/cooling/electricity delivery and regional fire/ambulance response support physical protection; early2026 heavy snow delayed response and local risk-grid gaps remain. Low historical heat/seismic proxies are context, not zero risk.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed physical services and completed works reasonably protect usual residents in FUA56 and persist at cutoff; their limited heat/coastal/geophysical coverage is not assumed complete. Remaining weather/common-dependency effects stay material. Rejecting this applicability/protection inference restores unknown.

dimensions.rationale: National Finnish strategic context and regional preparedness, occupational threat reports or ordinary rescue performance do not establish local organized-violence and geopolitical impact/mitigation. No UCDP match is not zero risk.
dimensions.assumption: No score; the missing bridge is a real local/regionally applicable threat consequence and implemented mitigation linked to resident/channel effects, not a perfect incident census.

dimensions.rationale: Regional public institutions implemented team/clinic and mobile-urgent-care changes in Turku, family reunification and home rehabilitation; actual audits and emergency response support execution. Information-transfer, technical assignment, staffing and service-chain problems persist.
dimensions.assumption: Regional governance and delivered municipal/operator services reasonably represent usual essential institutions for FUA56 residents. Existing group-access and recovery limits remain important after mitigation; neither national WGI nor budget balance establishes local resilience.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 water distribution, pipe renewal, heat/cooling/electricity delivery and interruption results support water/energy. Hospital catering and planned food research do not establish ordinary household food supply, net burden and practical alternatives.
dimensions.assumption: No whole-dimension score. Ordinary food purchase/distribution and access or a grounded applicability link is missing; no perfect household invoice is required. Food unknown is not observed shortage or poverty and cannot produce40.

dimensions.rationale: Public fees and expanded actual surgery/mobile urgent care provide paths;2025 over-six-month specialty wait fell20.2% to7.5% and surgery overdues1819 to758. The2025 report explicitly says early2026 acute elderly care-chain congestion persisted despite implemented improvements; transfers, ED and chronic follow-up displacement remain substantive limits.
dimensions.assumption: The documented necessary-care chain bottleneck reasonably affects ordinary Turku residents and remains important after alternatives at cutoff. If usual timely appropriate alternatives render the residual nonmaterial,60 is admissible; rejecting spatial/continuity/residual-importance inference restores unknown, not automatic40.

dimensions.rationale: Current TYKS CAR-T instructions explicitly describe locally supervised infusion and CRS/neurological management, stronger than a tariff. Named approved product and matching original human-efficacy chain, actual implementation identity at cutoff and public treatment approval are not verified;2021 transplants are not CAR-T counts.
dimensions.assumption: No score. A product-matched credible human/compliance bridge and dated actual local adoption plus appropriate usual public payment/monitoring would discriminate limited60/40. Counts and perfect median bills are not mandatory, but institution and general fees cannot fill product/implementation gaps.

dimensions.rationale: 2024 university sales/licensing87 and spin-offs4 connect with multiple real energy/water and healthcare deployments:23115 smart meters replaced2025, actual electric heat production and44% outpatient remote contacts. Technical doctor-assignment68%, congested chat and defective water-meter links persist despite functioning alternatives and free scheduled warranty repair.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed production and actual uptake reasonably represent major local industries and ordinary residents. The documented technical/service barriers remain important after actual mitigation; if strong capability and delivered assistance make them minor,80 is admissible rather than capped by missing high-tier measurements.

dimensions.rationale: Geometry verifies airport and two ports, not actual passenger routes or current exit availability. EU worker residence and accrued pension abroad provide limited legal/financial paths. Local operating transport and household international communication/account alternatives are not verified in the bounded review.
dimensions.assumption: No score; a dated real passenger exit channel and ordinary usability/alternative, plus an applicable key communication/account route would permit conditional assessment. Airport existence or fast Ookla samples do not replace these substantive links.
